title: Check Engine Warning
shortDescription: Yamaha ECM detected a diagnostic trouble code.
fullDescription:
Check Engine indicates a stored DTC. Pull codes via Yamaha Diagnostics System (YDS) or compatible scanner. The engine may run in guard mode.

Gasoline engines: keep bilge blower running, no sparks near fuel.

fixSteps.title: Follow DTC service
fixSteps.instruction: Service manual procedure for specific code.

whenToCallPro: If DTC points to injection or internal engine.
videoSearchQuery: Yamaha outboard check engine code read

title: Low Oil Pressure
shortDescription: Oil pressure below threshold; protection engaged.
fullDescription:
Yamaha engines will reduce RPM to idle to protect internals. Shut down and inspect oil level immediately.

Low oil causes rapid bearing damage; do not run.

fixSteps.title: Stop engine
fixSteps.instruction: Kill engine at idle return to dock slowly if safe.

fixSteps.title: Check oil
fixSteps.instruction: Dipstick check; top off with 10W-30 FC-W.

fixSteps.title: Replace switch
fixSteps.instruction: If oil is full, inspect/replace pressure switch.

whenToCallPro: If oil level is normal and switch replacement does not clear.
videoSearchQuery: Yamaha outboard oil pressure warning fix

faq.a: Helps but best action is shutdown.

title: Overheat Alarm
fullDescription:
Weak tell-tale stream or no flow typically indicates impeller or intake issue. Yamaha recommends annual impeller replacement.

Stop immediately to avoid head/piston damage.

fixSteps.title: Shut down
fixSteps.instruction: Kill engine and wait to cool.

fixSteps.title: Clear intake
fixSteps.instruction: Remove debris from lower unit screens.

fixSteps.title: Replace impeller
fixSteps.instruction: Remove lower unit and replace impeller and seal.

title: Fuel Pressure Low
shortDescription: Fuel rail pressure below expected value.
fullDescription:
Causes include clogged filter, failing fuel pump, or tank venting issue (vacuum lock). Runs rough or cuts out under load.

Replace fuel filters and inspect vent.

fixSteps.title: Replace filters
fixSteps.instruction: Change primary and on-engine fuel filters.

fixSteps.title: Check vent
fixSteps.instruction: Open fuel cap - if hiss, vent is blocked.

videoSearchQuery: Yamaha outboard fuel pressure low fix

title: Battery Voltage Low
fullDescription:
Weak battery or charging fault will set this alarm. Yamaha engines tolerate 12-14.5 V; below 11.5 V ECM function suffers.

Clean terminals and test the battery.

fixSteps.title: Clean terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Wire brush and coat with dielectric grease.

videoSearchQuery: Yamaha outboard battery voltage low fix

title: Power Trim/Tilt Fault
fullDescription:
Could be low hydraulic fluid, a failed trim switch, or relay issue. Operating with low fluid damages the pump.

Check fluid first.

fixSteps.title: Check fluid
fixSteps.instruction: Top reservoir with ATF or Yamalube PTF.

videoSearchQuery: Yamaha outboard trim tilt fault fix

faq.a: Yes via manual release valve for towing.

title: Water Detected in Fuel
fullDescription:
Drain separator at dock with bilge blower running. Gasoline and water must be disposed of per local regulations.

Replace filter element and check tank for further contamination.
whenToCallPro: If persistent; tank may need polishing.

title: MAP Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Intake pressure sensor out of range.
fullDescription:
Faulty MAP gives the ECM bad fueling data. Check vacuum port, wiring, and replace sensor.

Most Yamaha F150/F200 MAP sensors are easily accessible.

title: Throttle Position Sensor Fault
fullDescription:
Yamaha DEC (digital electronic control) relies on TPS. A fault forces idle-only limp mode. Usually requires a YDS calibration after replacement.

Replace sensor.

faq.a: Only if you own or can access YDS tool.

title: ECU Communication Error
shortDescription: Gauge/head cannot talk to engine ECU.
fullDescription:
Common causes: CAN bus termination missing, damaged harness, or failed gauge. Yamaha Command Link requires proper terminator resistors at bus ends.

Check terminators and harness continuity.

fixSteps.title: Check terminators
fixSteps.instruction: Both ends of Command Link bus need terminators.

affectedModels: Yamaha with Command Link / CL Plus
videoSearchQuery: Yamaha command link ECU communication error

faq.a: Yes, one at each end of the bus.

title: Crank Position Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Crank sensor signal lost or incorrect.
fullDescription:
Without a crank signal, the engine will not start or will stall. Sensor inspection and replacement typically resolve it.

Inspect for metal debris on the magnetic tip.

fixSteps.title: Replace CKP
fixSteps.instruction: Install new crank sensor per service manual.

title: Camshaft Position Sensor Fault
shortDescription: Cam sensor signal out of spec.
fullDescription:
Fault causes hard starting and misfires. Replace sensor; if CMP sensor fails due to debris, inspect timing chain/VCT for wear.

Often covered by extended warranty on F-series.
whenToCallPro: If debris indicates timing chain wear.

faq.a: Check Yamaha Y.E.S. extended warranty coverage.
